name: solving-algorithms
description: Comprehensive algorithm and data structure reference for competitive programming covering sorting, searching, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, computational geometry, and number theory with complexity analysis and language-agnostic implementations. Use when solving algorithmic problems, optimizing code for time/space complexity, or implementing classic data structures (stack, queue, heap, BST, union-find). For database-specific data structures (B-tree, LSM), use developing-databases instead.
author: sumik5
